import seaborn as sns

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
titanic = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Convert adult_male to categorical for proper visualization
titanic['adult_male'] = titanic['adult_male'].astype('category')

# Create a countplot for the survival rates based on sex
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.countplot(x='sex', hue='survived', data=titanic, ax=ax)
ax.set_title('Survival Rates by Sex')
ax.set_xlabel('Sex')
ax.set_ylabel('Count')
ax.legend(title='Survived')

# Create a bar chart for the average fare by class
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.barplot(x='pclass', y='fare', data=titanic, ax=ax)
ax.set_title('Average Fare by Class')
ax.set_xlabel('Class')
ax.set_ylabel('Average Fare')
